_: PINNED PHRASINGS for the human reading surface. These are FREE CHOICES — nothing in the object fixes the wording — so they are frozen ones. A surface whose words drift renders a different answer each release from the same measurement, and nobody could tell which changed. Change these by explicit operator amendment and bump `revision`.

layer1.heading: I read your input as being about:
layer1.declined: The proposer was consulted and drew no arrow to your input.
layer1.declined_detail: It was seated in a diagram of {objects} corpus claim(s) with {declared} declared arrow(s) already in it, and related none of them to what you typed. That is a decline, not a filter — and the rest of the corpus was not in this region, so it is unmeasured rather than ruled out.

layer2.heading: What answered:
layer2.none: Nothing in the field moved when your input was applied.

layer3.contested: This pressed on contested ground at: {where}
layer3.weakest: Weakest link in the chain: {arrow}, warranted at {tier}
layer3.faint: The field answered faintly — thin structure here, and everything it moved is provisional.
layer3.moderate: The field answered with moderate strength.
layer3.firm: The field answered firmly — the structure it moved through is confirmed.

forbidden_why: Gate 10 applies to the surface's wording as much as to a docstring. The surface RENDERS measured facts in plain words; it may not attribute a mental state to the field, and it may not use retrieval vocabulary, because the one thing this engine is not doing is matching.
